170 def extract_and_save_file(input_text):
171     """
172     Extracts the file name and code block from a text formatted as specified,
173     then creates a local file with the file name and writes the code into it.
174 
175     Args:
176     input_text (str): The text containing the file name and code block.
177 
178     Returns:
179     str: The name of the file created.
180     """
181     console = Console()
182     file_name_match = re.search(r"File Name:\s*(.*?)\s*\n+\s*Code:", input_text, re.DOTALL)
183     if not file_name_match:
184         console.log("File name not found in the text.")
185         return None, None
186 
187     file_name = file_name_match.group(1).strip()
188 
189     project_file_path = os.path.join(Config().read()['project']['path'], file_name)
190     code_match = re.search(r"```(?:[a-zA-Z0-9]+)?\n(.*?)```", input_text, re.DOTALL)
191     if not code_match:
192         console.log("Code block not found in the text.")
193         return None, None
194 
195     code = code_match.group(1).strip()
196     with open(project_file_path, 'w') as file:
197         file.write(code)
198 
199     return project_file_path, code
